items.label: https://zlib.net/current/zlib.tar.gz (permalink for the most recent release)

notes: Under 'The current release is publicly available here' the page lists zlib 1.4 source in tar.gz, tar.xz and zip, each as a 'US (zlib.net)' link; those three are included. The 'Permalink for the most recent release' link (current/zlib.tar.gz) directly below is also a direct archive of the current source release, so it is included too; this is the one judgement call, since it duplicates the tar.gz. Excluded: the GPG signature (.asc) links, the commented-out SourceForge mirrors and DLL (not rendered), 'All released versions of zlib' (fossils), zipknit17.tar.gz (other software), ZlibOCX2.dll, and all documentation and external links. Grading caveat: each archive key is a prefix of its .asc URL, so a result holding only the signatures would still match.
